value.body:
Amends the modulo rule: use n = lcm(|A|, |B|), not max. Jack Heart (2026-11-12), on A=5 seeds, B=2: "so if A has 5 seeds and B has 2 seeds, we get (0, 0), (1, 1), (2, 0), (3, 1) etc", then "yeahi was imagining balanced". Pair k in 0..n-1 is A[k mod |A|] vs B[k mod |B|], games split evenly over the n pairs (remainder to the lowest k). A=5, B=2, games=1000: 10 pairs of 100; every A seed plays both B seeds, 200 each; each B seed plays 500. Equal counts still give seed i vs seed i.
